name: overthinking_paralysis
description: Long reasoning_content blocks debating approaches, with very few corresponding tool calls. Most turns are pure thought. Eventually hits step budget without solving the task. Tests the analysis-paralysis penalty in action_success and tool_effectiveness.
task_instruction: There is a bug in /workspace/src/calc.py. The function multiply(a, b) currently returns a + b but should return a * b. Fix the bug and verify with your own tests before completing.
